name: Avila Energy Corporation
summary: Avila Energy Corporation operates as an integrated energy enterprise, concentrating on the exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas resources across Canada. The company holds a 50% passive interest in a productive oil and gas property, which spans approximately 7,680 acres in West Central Alberta. In December 2021, the firm officially adopted its current name, Avila Energy Corporation, having previously operated as Petro Viking Energy Inc. Its corporate headquarters are located in Calgary, Canada.
